proposals.before: Mi said: "Deciding victory between two battle lines—alas, in a shout or a sigh, enough to terrify the enemy—I am not your equal.
proposals.after: Mi said: "Deciding victory between two battle lines—in a shout or a sigh, enough to terrify the enemy—I am not your equal.
proposals.reason: 噫嗚咄嗟 describes a shout in an instant, not an English interjection of regret; 'alas' invents a lament absent from the Chinese.

proposals.before: If we march in force on Ji and seize its throat, Goguryeo will hold him on one front and we on the other. In less than ten days his supplies will run out. Raise the banner and summon him, and his whole army can be taken. Then issue proclamations southward and the realm will be settled—that is the best plan.
proposals.after: If we march in force on Ji and seize its throat, Goguryeo will hold him on one front and we on the other. In less than ten days or a month his supplies will run out. Raise the banner and summon him, and his whole army can be taken. Then issue proclamations southward and the realm will be settled—that is the best plan.
proposals.reason: 不旬月 is a span of a xun up to a month, not 'ten days' alone; the idiomatic line drops 月.

proposals.before: Mi told his confidants, "Xuangan delights in turning back and does not plan for victory. We shall become captives!"
proposals.after: Mi told his confidants, "Xuangan delights in revolt and does not plan for victory. We shall become captives!"
proposals.reason: 好反 means fondness for rebellion, not 'turning back'; the translation reverses the military-political sense of 反.

proposals.before: Mi said to those close to him: "Xuangan delights in turning back and does not plan for victory—we shall become captives!"
proposals.after: Mi said to those close to him: "Xuangan delights in revolt and does not plan for victory—we shall become captives!"
proposals.reason: The literal line repeats the same mistranslation of 好反 as 'turning back' rather than revolt.

proposals.before: They brought out all their gold and showed it to the supervising escort. "Since we are about to die," they said, "we beg you to accept this in gratitude."
proposals.after: They brought out all their gold and showed it to the supervising escort. "Since we are about to die," they said, "we beg you to repay us this kindness."
proposals.reason: Chinese 幸報德 asks the escort to repay kindness; idiomatic English invents 'accept this in gratitude' and drops 報.

proposals.before: If you take the Xingluo Granary directly, open the grain to relieve the destitute, a force of a million can rally to you in a morning, and the enterprise of a true king is accomplished."
proposals.after: If you take the Xingluo Granary directly, open the grain to relieve the destitute, a force of a million can rally to you in a morning, and the enterprise of a frost-king is accomplished."
proposals.reason: Chinese 霜王之業 is rendered 'true king', which drops 霜; the literal field already keeps 'king of frost'.

proposals.before: In the fourth month, Sui Tiger Cage General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered, and Meng Rang of the Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
proposals.after: In the fourth month, Sui Hulao General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered, and Meng Rang of the Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
proposals.reason: 虎牢 is the Hulao Pass, not a tiger cage; the office is the Sui general at Hulao.

proposals.before: In the fourth month, Sui Tiger Cage General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered; Meng Rang of Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
proposals.after: In the fourth month, Sui Hulao General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered; Meng Rang of Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
proposals.reason: 虎牢 is the Hulao Pass; the literal rendering should not calque 虎 and 牢 as tiger cage.

proposals.before: When Mi heard of this, he and Zheng Hui secretly plotted against Rang.
proposals.after: When Mi heard of this, he and Zheng Ting secretly plotted against Rang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄭颋 is Zheng Ting; Hui mistranscribes the given name 颋.

proposals.reason: Chinese 鄭颋 is Zheng Ting; Hui mistranscribes the given name 颋.

proposals.before: Director of Palace Construction Yuwen Kai's son Rutong, Henan Garrison Director of Office of Works Lang Liu Xu, Heyang Commandant Dugu Wudu, and Henei Commandery Assistant Director Liu Xie all surrendered.
proposals.after: Director of Palace Construction Yuwen Kai's son Rutong, Henan Garrison Vice Director of the Bureau of Operations Liu Xu, Heyang Commandant Dugu Wudu, and Henei Commandery Assistant Director Liu Xie all surrendered.
proposals.reason: 職方郎 is a Bureau of Operations director, not an Office of Works Lang.

proposals.before: Pei Renji and Zu Junyan were both captured by Shichong. Yanshi coerced Zheng Hui to defect and return to Shichong.
proposals.after: Pei Renji and Zu Junyan were both captured by Shichong. Yanshi coerced Zheng Ting to defect and return to Shichong.
proposals.reason: Chinese 鄭颋 is Zheng Ting (tǐng); Hui does not match 颋.

proposals.before: They plundered livestock and hurried east toward the southern mountains, galloping to notify Zhang Shansxiang to bring troops to support them.
proposals.after: They plundered livestock and hurried east toward the southern mountains, galloping to notify Zhang Shanxiang to bring troops to support them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 張善相 is Zhang Shanxiang; Shansxiang is a corrupted English spelling.

proposals.before: Shiji submitted a memorial requesting permission to collect and bury the body. An edict returned the corpse. He then held funeral rites with full ceremony. The three armies wore white hemp, and Mi was buried with the rites due a lord five li southwest of Mount Li in Liyang. The mound was seven ren high.
proposals.after: Shiji submitted a memorial requesting permission to collect and bury the body. An edict returned the corpse. He then held funeral rites with full ceremony. The three armies wore white hemp, and Mi was buried with the rites due a lord five li southwest of Liyang Mountain. The mound was seven ren high.
proposals.reason: 黎陽山 is Liyang Mountain, not a separate Mount Li in Liyang.

proposals.before: When Bing Yuanzhen surrendered, Shichong made him Vice Director of the Great Headquarters and garrisoned Huazhou.
proposals.after: When Bing Yuanzhen surrendered, Shichong made him Vice Director of the Branch Headquarters and garrisoned Huazhou.
proposals.reason: 行臺仆射 is vice-director of a branch (xingtai) administration, not a Great Headquarters.

proposals.before: Appendix: Zu Junyan. Zu Junyan was the son of Qi Minister over the Masses Xiaozheng.
proposals.after: Appendix: Zu Junyan. Zu Junyan was the son of Qi Vice Director Xiaozheng.
proposals.reason: 齐仆射 is puye (Vice Director), not Minister over the Masses (司徒).

proposals.before: Appendix: Zu Junyan. Zu Junyan was the son of Qi Minister over the Masses Xiaozheng.
proposals.after: Appendix: Zu Junyan. Zu Junyan was the son of Qi Vice Director Xiaozheng.
proposals.reason: The literal English repeats the same office mistranslation of 仆射.

proposals.before: Xue Daheng once recommended him to Emperor Wen of Sui. The emperor said, "Is this not the son of the man who killed Hulü Mingyue?
proposals.after: Xue Daoheng once recommended him to Emperor Wen of Sui. The emperor said, "Is this not the son of the man who killed Hulü Mingyue?
proposals.reason: 薛道衡 is Xue Daoheng; Daheng corrupts 道衡.

proposals.after: Xue Daoheng once recommended him to Emperor Wen of Sui. The emperor said: "Is this not the son of the man who killed Hulü Mingyue?

decisions.reason: 噫嗚咄嗟 is an instantaneous shout, not a lament; 'alas' invents regret absent from 密曰：「決兩陣之勝，噫嗚咄嗟」.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 決兩陣之勝，噫嗚咄嗟，足以詟敵

decisions.reason: 不旬月 is a xun-to-month span, so 'ten days' alone drops 月; 'ten days or a month' restores both 旬 and 月.
好反而不圖勝 means he is fond of revolt without planning to win; 'turning back' misreads 反 as a retreat.
The literal repeats the same error: 好反 is revolt, not turning back, in 玄感好反而不圖勝.

decisions.after: They brought out all their gold and showed it to the supervising escort. "Since we are about to die," they said, "we beg you to repay this kindness."
decisions.reason: 幸報德 asks the escort to repay kindness, so 'accept this in gratitude' is wrong; 'repay us this kindness' is awkward—repay this kindness is the natural wording.

decisions.after: If you take the Xingluo Granary directly, open the grain to relieve the destitute, a force of a million can rally to you in a morning, and the enterprise of a king of frost is accomplished."
decisions.reason: 霜王之業 is not a 'true king', so the original omits 霜; hyphenated 'frost-king' is awkward. Use the chapter's own 'king of frost' wording.
虎牢 is Hulao Pass; 隋虎牢將 is the Sui general at Hulao, not a 'Tiger Cage' calque of 虎 and 牢.
The literal likewise calques 虎牢 as Tiger Cage; Hulao General matches 隋虎牢將.
鄭颋 is Zheng Ting; Hui does not transcribe 颋 and invents a different given name.
The literal has the same mistranscription of 鄭颋 as Zheng Hui; Ting is required.

decisions.after: Director of Palace Construction Yuwen Kai's son Rutong, Henan Garrison Director of the Bureau of Operations Liu Xu, Heyang Commandant Dugu Wudu, and Henei Commandery Assistant Director Liu Xie all surrendered.
decisions.reason: 職方郎 is the Bureau of Operations, not Office of Works, but 郎 is director-rank, not 員外 vice-director. Restore Bureau of Operations as Director.
偃師劫鄭颋 again names 鄭颋, Zheng Ting; Hui does not match 颋.
The literal repeats Zheng Hui for 鄭颋; the given name must be Ting.
張善相 is Zhang Shanxiang; Shansxiang inserts an extra s not present in 善相.
The literal has the same corrupted spelling Shansxiang for 張善相; Shanxiang is correct.
黎陽山 is one toponym, Liyang Mountain, not Mount Li located in Liyang.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以君禮葬黎陽山西南五里

decisions.reason: 行臺仆射 is puye of a branch (xingtai) administration; Great Headquarters is not 行臺.
齊仆射 is Qi puye (Vice Director), not 司徒 Minister over the Masses.
The literal repeats Minister over the Masses for 仆射; Vice Director matches the office.
薛道衡 is Xue Daoheng; Daheng corrupts 道衡 by dropping 道.
The literal likewise writes Xue Daheng for 薛道衡; Daoheng is the correct transcription.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0007/r0008 show 'Tiger Cage' came only from calquing 虎牢; the title claim must read Hulao while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, and evidence.
The office English label repeats the Tiger Cage calque of 虎牢將; Hulao General is the supported office name.
Accepted r0009/r0010 show English Hui came only from mistranscribing 颋; the personal-name claim must read Zheng Ting.
Accepted r0012/r0013 show both English Hui and pinyin Hui were created by the bad transcription of 鄭颋; restore Zheng Ting.
Accepted r0014/r0015 show Shansxiang is a spelling corruption of 張善相; the English personal name must be Zhang Shanxiang.
Accepted r0020/r0021 show English Daheng came only from corrupting 道衡; the personal-name claim must read Xue Daoheng.
